script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

for _, tool in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
    if tool:IsA("Tool") then
        tool:Destroy()
    end
end

for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
    if tool:IsA("Tool") then
        tool:Destroy()
    end
end

local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local events = {
    replicatedStorage.Ellen.Yuji.RemoteEvent,
    replicatedStorage.Ellen.Yuji.RemoteEvent2,
    replicatedStorage.Ellen.Yuji.RemoteEvent3,
    replicatedStorage.Ellen.Yuji.RemoteEvent4,
}

local attackDelay = 0.35
local cooldownTime = 0.75
local resetTime = 2
local currentIndex = 1
local isCooldown = false
local lastAttackTime = os.clock()

local toolM1 = Instance.new("Tool")
toolM1.Name = "M1s"
toolM1.RequiresHandle = false
toolM1.Parent = backpack

toolM1.Activated:Connect(function()
    if isCooldown then return end
    isCooldown = true

    events[currentIndex]:FireServer()
    lastAttackTime = os.clock()

    if currentIndex == #events then
        task.wait(cooldownTime)
        currentIndex = 1
    else
        currentIndex += 1
        task.wait(attackDelay)
    end

    isCooldown = false
end)

local function createCooldownTool(name, activateFunction, cooldown)
    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = name
    tool.RequiresHandle = false
    tool.Parent = backpack
    local cooldownValue = Instance.new("NumberValue", tool)
    cooldownValue.Value = 0

    local function startCooldown()
        cooldownValue.Value = cooldown
        while cooldownValue.Value > 0 do
            tool.Name = name .. " (" .. string.format("%.1f", cooldownValue.Value) .. "s)"
            task.wait(0.1)
            cooldownValue.Value -= 0.1
        end
        tool.Name = name
    end

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        if cooldownValue.Value > 0 then return end
        activateFunction()
        startCooldown()
    end)
end

createCooldownTool("blood bullet", function()
    replicatedStorage.Remotes.ballz2:FireServer()
    wait()
    replicatedStorage.Remotes.beam:FireServer()
end, 2)

createCooldownTool("strong kick", function()
    replicatedStorage.Kj.Remotes:FindFirstChild("Sweep Swift"):FireServer()
    replicatedStorage.Remotes.sniper:FireServer()
end, 10)

createCooldownTool("hot and cold", function()
    replicatedStorage.sukuna.remotes:FindFirstChild("fire arrow"):FireServer()
    wait(0.5)
    replicatedStorage.CompassNeedle.RemoteEvent:FireServer()
end, 8.5)

createCooldownTool("powerful shot", function()
    replicatedStorage.Remotes.ballz:FireServer()
    wait()
    replicatedStorage.Remotes.sniper:FireServer()
end, 2.2)
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local function playSound(assetId)
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = assetId
    sound.Parent = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character
    sound:Play()
    sound.Ended:Connect(function()
        sound:Destroy()
    end)
end

local function playAnimation(assetId)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        animation.AnimationId = assetId
        local track = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
        track:Play()
    end
end

local function destroyAllTools()
    for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if tool:IsA("Tool") then
            tool:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local equippedTool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if equippedTool then
        equippedTool:Destroy()
    end
end

local function activateScript()
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth > 0.5 then
        warn("Cannot activate tool. HP is above 50%.")
        return
    end

    local healingRemote = replicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("Healing")
    if healingRemote and healingRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        healingRemote:FireServer(" ")
    end
    playSound("rbxassetid://577577319")
    playAnimation("rbxassetid://125383777732172")

    task.delay(0.1, destroyAllTools)
wait (0.5)

local function createCooldownTool(name, activateFunction, cooldown)
    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = name
    tool.RequiresHandle = false
    tool.Parent = backpack
    local cooldownValue = Instance.new("NumberValue", tool)
    cooldownValue.Value = 0

    local function startCooldown()
        cooldownValue.Value = cooldown
        while cooldownValue.Value > 0 do
            tool.Name = name .. " (" .. string.format("%.1f", cooldownValue.Value) .. "s)"
            task.wait(0.1)
            cooldownValue.Value -= 0.1
        end
        tool.Name = name
    end

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        if cooldownValue.Value > 0 then return end
        activateFunction()
        startCooldown()
    end)
end
